parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing continents, countries, and oceans. It can rotate around its axis for educational and reference purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the tilted axis supported by the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, typically made of wood, providing stability and support for the rotating sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the axis and sphere in place, ensuring the globe remains upright and balanced during rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
